q: In March 2025, what multiplier was paid for day D2 work in hour band H2? Answer under the version of the overtime rate that was in force on that date.
log:
The applicable version for March 2025 is `hard-overtime-v2` (in force 2024-07-01 to 2025-12-31), indexed by day and hours only.

**Answer: For day D2, hour band H2, the multiplier was 1.35x.**
